notes.title: Regarding to Episode 3.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/e46b105dabb41a5c38f6685a63c76896e6667ae9.png[/img]
[h2]
ZORT – Episode 3 Delay[/h2]

Hey ZORT players

We know a lot of you have been waiting for Episode 3, and we're really sorry we couldn’t release it on the date we announced.

Things didn’t go as planned, and instead of rushing it, we decided to take more time to make sure everything feels right. We don’t want to give you a half-finished experience, and we hope you understand that.

We’re not ready to share a new release date yet, but we’ll let you know as soon as we can. In the meantime, we’re working day and night to make the game the best it can be.

Also, we’ll soon be sharing some new visuals and sneak peeks.

Thanks for your patience.


Londer Software Team

notes.content:

[h2]Episode 3: Seagate[/h2]
We would like to inform you that we have started working on the 3rd episode. Although we cannot say an exact date, we aim to release it in the first quarter of 2025. 🦜🏴‍☠️

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed presents since it was temporary for the new year. Other new year stuff will be available for a little while. You can return to the presents branch from steam betas named "presents". But that version will not be updated.
[*] Fixed deactivating mines didn't show for clients.
[*] Fixed mines exploding constantly for some reason.
[/list]

notes.title: 🚨MINOR UPDATE 0.2.5🚨

notes.title: 🚨MINOR UPDATE 0.2.3🚨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/8da0cb3cab3f8b16ecbb28785f9d778d2a4422ac.png[/img]

[h2]HOME SWEET HOME[/h2]
We made some changes to [b]Zortagene [/b]upon your request. Thanks to the changes we made, [b]Zortagene [/b]is easier than before. 🐢

We have given a good beating to the creatures that constantly harass you. We have also made many changes to prevent you from reaching the end of the [b]Zortagene[/b] and losing. 💀

We hope these changes give you a better gaming experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/df619bc40ab6ba9cb0fbdc7e3a8b4a9a9596586c.gif[/img]

[h2]IS THAT ALL?[/h2]
We fixed silly deaths and possible bugs. We don't want to prevent chaos completely.

We aim to keep it as consistent as possible. In this process, we take into account the feedback on our discord server. We care about what you want in our game.
[url=https://discord.gg/EHAS3Fd5rG]Our Community Discord Server[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/f94098ff7e1a2c0adffc136efb03b8e2b65379af.gif[/img]

[h2]WHAT IS IT THAT I HEAR?[/h2]

Music is one of the subjects we care most about. We aimed to make music that people can listen to in daily life, rather than just generic music that plays in the background while playing the game.

With this update, we fixed some bugs in the musics in the game. The concert part is one of the most important.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/466897902402566514477f49a9f29f0595101b6b.gif[/img]

[h2]🚨PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added ability to kick players out of lobby.
[*] Added cooldowns to some UI noises.
[*] More things can now be punched with the boxing gloves.
[*] Fixed Osman dragging the player at absurd positions.
[*] You will now start episode 2 looking at the direction that you have to go.
[*] Fixed getting stuck out of the elevator in Episode 2.
[*] Now there is a way to deactivate a land mine :)
[*] Fixed the lighting issues with the hint signs.
[*] Once the concert starts, instruments will be teleported back to the concert zone.
[*] Episode 1: Floor 2 Factory nerfed.
[*] Episode 1: Floor 3 Escape Garage HUGE nerfed, so now my granny can pass that level easily...
[*] Rat chase music increased
[*] Many fixed unlisted here...
[/list]
and many more technical things...

notes.title: EPISODE 2: YOZGAT MINOR UPDATE | MANY BUG FIXES

notes.title: EPISODE 2: YOZGAT UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/36512e833df063f95e2c4c74d3e81c9e8d6476c9.png[/img]

[h3]If you think something is gonna work , the chances are that it is probably gonna work. So get creative when interacting with enemies and items![/h3]

We’ve added an exciting new map called [b]Yozgat[/b].
This is a dark and vast terrain filled with unique and terrifying creatures. As you try to escape their clutches, you’ll experience moments of pure fear, but also incredible fun! 🐢

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Map.
[*] New characters.
[*] New items.
[*] New mechanics.
[*] Many bug fixes.
[*] Fixes for Zortagane.
[/list]
Get ready for a thrilling adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/595cd6f55e40d4f42c39e3a7dbda14ac28dcd702.png[/img]

Not just these!
We added more interesting events related to [b]Skinwalkers[/b].
We don't want to spoil the secret by giving spoilers. We hope that there are events that will surprise you when you see them in the game.

notes.title: 🚨 MINOR UPDATE 🚨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/c96bbb0aaf82b2e06cdfdfc5b1db833b0acf47e8.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Localization and languages[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some typos in all languages.
[*] Added in spanish.
[/list]

[h2][b]We worked on making you play the game better...[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the echo effect remaining on players' voices after falling into holes
[*] Many of the unclear areas where you need to progress in the game have been clarified.
[*] Reduced the spawn rate of mimic creatures.
[*] The error in purchasing items from vending machines has been fixed.
[*] The settings menu has been made more functional.
[*] Sound detectors (ZORTO) have been heavily nerfed. They can no longer be heard from a distance and a time period has been added before they can work again.
[*] Fixed a lot of collision bugs.
[*] Fixed monsters getting stuck while walking.
[*] Fixed Dexter's walking error after being scared.
[*] Ambient sound bugs have been fixed.
[*] Character story music has been fixed.
[*] Noise pollution in the game has been prevented to a large extent.
[*] Errors related to the number of players in the cinematic have been fixed.
[*] Added hidden antis to creatures.
[*] Spider mimics can now be kicked. All you have to do is walk on it.
[/list]

notes.title: 🚨 FIRST DAY PATCH 🚨
notes.content:
In this first episode, you will encounter other creatures while trying to escape from the factory.

[b]Improvements and bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed items not working when exiting and re-entering the game.
[*] Notes and some environment details have been localized to all other supported languages.
[*] Holes have been added to the map. Thus, moving around the place became more difficult. You can also have fun moments by pushing your friends into holes.
[*] Some lighting bugs fixed
[*] Dexter's chance of appearing has been reduced
[*] The chance of Skinwalker appearing has been reduced
[*] The chance of ManSlender appearing has been reduced
[*] Jimmy's key was moved to a much more prominent location
[*] The saw in the factory was moved to a much more prominent place
[*] Important items were made shiny
[*] Important notes highlighted
[*] Fixed bugs when using Zorti
[/list]
